name: offboardingCompletionRate
definition: The percent (0 to 100) of the people Vanta has in offboarding whose offboarding tasks are complete.
population: the people whose Vanta task status is OFFBOARDING_COMPLETE, OFFBOARDING_DUE_SOON or OFFBOARDING_OVERDUE; denominator = that set
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete paged read of Vanta's people list, every entry readable with a known status, and at least one person in offboarding. Anything less is Not evaluated.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation, a Vanta third-party-proof (level 3) transform. Synthetic-fixture tests only; no real Vanta body with values was replayed, so V0.

notes: Vanta's offboarding task state for logical access control. It shows offboarding was recorded as done, not that an account was disabled; level 3 third-party proof.
